title: Finding a gadget chain in a supplied classpath
prerequisites: a deserialization sink that accepts attacker-influenced bytes
the dependency set the application actually loads
excerpt: Gadget chains are a property of the loaded libraries, not of the payload format. Inventory the versions in the supplied artefact, look for classes whose read-object path reaches a file, network or process call, and only then ask whether the sink can reach them. A chain you cannot explain class by class is a scanner result rather than a demonstrated effect.
